EQA.name: Computational Proof Reproduction
EQA.description: Takes a published theorem or equation and implements it as executable, CI-tested code. Asks: does running this implementation reproduce the numerical results claimed in the paper, at the stated precision, under the stated conditions?

BAV.name: Biomedical AI Pipeline Governance
BAV.description: Audits the full biomedical AI pipeline from molecule input to clinical decision output. Multi-model disagreement is treated as a signal to investigate, not noise to smooth over.

BSC.name: Bioscience Repository Compliance
BSC.description: Static, zero-execution safety scans of public bioscience AI repositories. Maps findings to the MIT AI Risk Repository (AIRI) 4-tier evidence-readiness classification.

verdicts.label: Pass
verdicts.meaning: All checks passed; reproduction or classification succeeded within stated bounds.

verdicts.label: Degraded pass
verdicts.meaning: Partial pass: some checks passed but with scope caveats or boundary limitations.

verdicts.label: Accept with bounds
verdicts.meaning: Research-viable as a supporting construct within explicitly stated bounds; not suitable for core promotion.

verdicts.label: Block
verdicts.meaning: Hard constraint violation triggered; dangerous false-pass risk identified. Advancement blocked.

verdicts.label: Gate rejected
verdicts.meaning: Claim scope exceeds what the mathematical or technical construction supports.

verdicts.label: Fail
verdicts.meaning: Pipeline failure surface identified; PASS-eligible controls routed incorrectly.

verdicts.label: Keep observer
verdicts.meaning: All arms unverified; multi-model disagreement kept visible as signal rather than resolved by majority vote.

verdicts.label: Honest abstain
verdicts.meaning: Calibration metrics are statistically sound on pilot data, but cross-domain consistency fails; system correctly declined to claim generalisation.

verdicts.label: Truthful null
verdicts.meaning: Gate rejected all candidates quickly and correctly. Value is in what was NOT built: confirmed negative rather than a failure to find a positive.

verdicts.label: High Risk
verdicts.meaning: Significant deficiencies. Use only with explicit mitigations and documented limitations. (BSC lane)

verdicts.label: Caution
verdicts.meaning: Partial compliance. Usable with acknowledged limitations and active monitoring. (BSC lane)

sr9.name: Cross-domain consistency (SR9)
sr9.description: Can the pipeline reasoning transfer across domains it was not explicitly trained on?

di2.name: Reasoning deviation (DI2)
di2.description: How far does the model internal logic drift from its stated claims?

p_e2e.name: End-to-end reliability (p_e2e)
p_e2e.description: Probability that a true positive survives the full pipeline: input capture x signal transfer x model correct x clinical decision correct.

balanced_accuracy.name: Balanced accuracy
balanced_accuracy.description: Mean of PASS recall and BLOCK recall. 1.0 = perfect discrimination; 0.5 = random.

brier_score.name: Brier score
brier_score.description: Calibration quality: mean squared error between predicted probabilities and outcomes. 0.0 = perfect calibration.

final_score_bsc.name: BSC compliance score
final_score_bsc.description: Weighted composite: 0.4 x README intent + 0.2 x consistency + 0.4 x code safety. Risk penalty subtracted. Capped at 69 for clinical-adjacent repositories without an explicit boundary statement.

disclaimer: All entries are archival evidence records. They do not constitute certification, regulatory approval, or clinical recommendation. Internal pipeline metrics (SR9, DI2, p_e2e) are advisory Flamehaven-internal scores, not externally validated. Verification weight rests on external anchors: public MIT repositories, the Zenodo DOI, and standard third-party metrics such as AlphaFold pLDDT and PAE.
